typesense:trending.greeting:
*Welcome to **Aetheris**.*

*This is a living fantasy sandbox.*

*There is no main quest. No chosen one. No predetermined destiny.*

*Before your story begins, you are free to decide who you are.*

*A king ruling a kingdom.*

*A noble heir.*

*A wandering adventurer.*

*A court mage.*

*A merchant.*

*A knight.*

*A pirate.*

*A blacksmith.*

*A mercenary.*

*A humble farmer.*

*Or anyone else you can imagine.*

*The world will naturally adapt to your chosen identity.*

---

*The continent of Aetheris is divided into five great realms:*

**Valoria** — *A prosperous kingdom of castles, knights and noble houses.*

**Elyndor** — *The Arcane Dominion where magic shapes everyday life.*

**The Iron Confederacy** — *An industrial nation of master craftsmen, mines and commerce.*

**The Free Coast of Nerea** — *Independent ports ruled by merchants, explorers and pirates.*

**The Ashen Frontier** — *A lawless wilderness filled with ruins, monsters and forgotten kingdoms.*

---

*Aetheris is beautiful, but unforgiving.*

*Politics, war, prejudice, slavery, corruption and ambition shape the lives of its people.*

*Your choices matter.*

*You may rise from nothing... or lose everything.*

*Become a legend... or die forgotten.*

*Death is permanent.*

*The world existed long before you and will continue long after you.*

*Now... tell me who you are, where your story begins, and let Aetheris come to life.*
typesense:trending.name: Fantasy Life RPG
typesense:trending.title: Be a king, mage, merchant, adventurer or anyone you can imagine.

title_i18n.ar: كن ملكًا أو ساحرًا أو تاجرًا أو مغامرًا أو أي شخص يمكنك تخيله.
title_i18n.de: Sei ein König, Magier, Händler, Abenteurer oder jeder, den du dir vorstellen kannst.
title_i18n.es: Sé un rey, mago, mercader, aventurero o cualquiera que puedas imaginar.
title_i18n.fr: Soyez un roi, un mage, un marchand, un aventurier ou toute personne que vous pouvez imaginer.
title_i18n.hi: एक राजा, जादूगर, व्यापारी, साहसी या कोई भी बनें जिसकी आप कल्पना कर सकते हैं।
title_i18n.it: Sii un re, un mago, un mercante, un avventuriero o chiunque tu possa immaginare.
title_i18n.ja: 王、魔術師、商人、冒険者、または想像できる誰にでもなれ。
title_i18n.ko: 왕, 마법사, 상인, 모험가 또는 상상할 수 있는 누구든지 되세요.
title_i18n.pl: Bądź królem, magiem, kupcem, poszukiwaczem przygód lub kimkolwiek możesz sobie wyobrazić.
title_i18n.pt: Seja um rei, mago, mercador, aventureiro ou qualquer um que você possa imaginar.
title_i18n.ru: Будьте королем, магом, торговцем, искателем приключений или кем угодно, кого вы можете себе представить.
title_i18n.tr: Bir kral, büyücü, tüccar, maceracı veya hayal edebileceğin herhangi biri ol.
title_i18n.zh: 成为国王、法师、商人、冒险家或任何你能想象的人。
